import itertools

from semver_range import satisfies, max_satisfying


def sat(version, range_):
    return satisfies(version, range_)


def check(version, range_, expected):
    got = sat(version, range_)
    assert got is expected, "%r satisfies %r: got %r, expected %r" % (
        version,
        range_,
        got,
        expected,
    )


def invalid_version(version):
    try:
        satisfies(version, "*")
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected invalid version: %r" % (version,))


def invalid_range(range_):
    try:
        satisfies("1.2.3", range_)
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected invalid range: %r" % (range_,))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- versions
valid_versions = [
    "0.0.0",
    "1.2.3",
    "v1.2.3",
    "=1.2.3",
    " 1.2.3 ",
    "1.2.3-alpha",
    "1.2.3-alpha.1",
    "1.2.3+build.5",
    "1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5",
    "1.2.3-0",
    "1.2.3--",
    "1.2.3-alpha-1",
    "1.2.3+001",
    "1.2.3+ABC.xyz-9",
]
for version in valid_versions:
    check(version, "=" + version.strip(), True)

for version in [
    "",
    "1.2",
    "1.2.3.4",
    "01.2.3",
    "1.02.3",
    "1.2.03",
    "1.2.3-01",
    "1.2.3-alpha.01",
    "1.2.3-",
    "1.2.3+",
    "1.2.3-alpha..1",
    "1.2.3+abc..1",
    "1.2.3-alpha_beta",
    "1.2.3+build+extra",
    "v=1.2.3",
    "V1.2.3",
    "vv1.2.3",
]:
    invalid_version(version)

# SemVer precedence chain from the spec.
chain = [
    "1.0.0-alpha",
    "1.0.0-alpha.1",
    "1.0.0-alpha.beta",
    "1.0.0-beta",
    "1.0.0-beta.2",
    "1.0.0-beta.11",
    "1.0.0-rc.1",
    "1.0.0",
]
for earlier, later in zip(chain, chain[1:]):
    check(later, ">" + earlier, True)
    check(earlier, "<" + later, True)
    check(later, ">" + later, False)
    check(earlier, "=" + later, False)

# Build metadata is ignored.

check("1.2.3+build.1", "=1.2.3+build.2", True)
check("1.2.3+build.1", ">1.2.3", False)

    check("1.2.0", range_, True)
    check("1.2.99", range_, True)
    check("1.1.9", range_, False)
    check("1.3.0", range_, False)
    check("1.3.0-0", range_, False)
    check("1.2.0-alpha", range_, False)

for range_ in ["1", "1.x", "1.x.x"]:
    check("1.0.0", range_, True)
    check("1.9.9", range_, True)
    check("0.9.9", range_, False)
    check("2.0.0", range_, False)

for range_ in ["*", "x", "X"]:
    check("0.0.0", range_, True)
    check("5.0.0", range_, True)
    check("1.0.0-rc.1", range_, False)

check("1.3.0", ">1.2", True)
check("1.2.9", ">1.2", False)
check("2.0.0", ">1", True)
check("1.9.9", ">1", False)
check("1.2.0", ">=1.2", True)
check("1.2.9", ">=1.2", True)
check("1.1.9", ">=1.2", False)
check("1.1.9", "<1.2", True)
check("1.2.0", "<1.2", False)
check("1.2.0-alpha", "<1.2", False)
check("1.2.9", "<=1.2", True)
check("1.3.0", "<=1.2", False)
check("1.2.0-alpha", "<=1.2", False)
check("1.9.9", "<=1", True)

check("1.2.9", "=1.2", True)
check("1.3.0", "=1.2", False)

for range_ in [">=*", "<=*"]:

    check("5.0.0", range_, True)
    check("1.0.0-rc.1", range_, False)

check("1.2.3", "= 1.2.3", True)
check("1.2.3", "~ 1.2.3", True)
check("1.2.3", "^ 1.2.3", True)

check("1.2.99", "~1.2.3", True)
check("1.2.2", "~1.2.3", False)

check("1.3.0", "~1.2", False)

check("1.2.3", "~1.2.3-beta.2", True)

check("1.3.0-beta", "~1.2.3-beta.2", False)

check("2.0.0", "^1.2.3", False)

check("1.2.3", "^1.2.3-beta.2", True)

    check("0.0.9", range_, True)

check("0.1.9", "^0.1", True)
check("0.2.0", "^0.1", False)

check("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4", True)
check("2.3.4", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4", True)
